verdict.rationale: Folk documents its own person-enrichment capability: an API to enrich up to 500 people per request and a `person_enrichment.finished` webhook event. "Contact enrichment" also appears as a plan feature on the pricing page. The evidence covers on-request enrichment of people only, and none of it addresses company records, firmographic fields, or automatic enrichment without a request. missing for 10: company/firmographic enrichment, automatic (non-request-triggered) enrichment, detail on which contact data fields are enriched, independent or hands-on corroboration.
